note: Initial floor for cyclomatic complexity in the bundled addons tree. Scope: 'ruff check addons/ --no-cache --select C901', threshold [lint.mccabe] max-complexity = 20 in ruff.toml. Measured 93 with ruff 0.16.2, the requirements-dev.txt pin. Companion to the c901 floor, which measures 'odoo/' (the core package) and therefore said nothing at all about the 615 bundled addons -- where most of the fork's business logic actually lives. Deliberately a SECOND file rather than a widened scope on c901: the two trees move for different reasons and by different hands, and folding them would let an addons cleanup mask a core regression (and vice versa), which is the exact failure mode the core floor was split out of the ruff aggregate to avoid. Distribution at the floor: 93 functions over the threshold, top offenders addons/web/models/web_read.py::web_read at 67, l10n_in/models/account_move_line.py::_get_l10n_in_gstr_section at 57, account/models/chart_template.py::_pre_reload_data at 56, documents/models/documents_document.py::write at 55. account contributes 11 of the 93, three of them in chart_template.py -- that file, not account_move.py, is the module's real complexity hotspot. Raising max-complexity lowers this count without fixing anything -- move the threshold only with the same deliberation as the count, and record it here. Command: ruff check addons/ --no-cache --select C901 --statistics | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'
